children: XRP fell to about 87 cents on Saturday, November 21, breaking below its previous November lows and reaching its lowest price since November 2024. The token was down about 9% over 24 hours and 11.5% over the week. It has lost about 13% since it traded at $1.00 on Wednesday (calculated). The drop pushed net assets in the five US spot XRP ETFs below $1 billion.
XRP Falls With the Broader Crypto Market
The selloff spread across crypto as bitcoin fell below $57,000 to a two-year low. Ether dropped more than 10%, SOL more than 9% and Zcash 19%.
Long Positions Account for 94% of Liquidations

About $18 million in XRP futures positions were liquidated over 24 hours, roughly 94% of them bets on rising prices, according to CoinGlass. XRP futures open interest stood near $1.77 billion, with more than $3 billion in trading volume over the period.
Funding rates turned negative on major exchanges. Negative funding means traders holding short positions pay those holding longs, a sign that bearish bets dominate.
Spot ETF Assets Slip to $990 Million

The five US spot XRP ETFs now hold about $990 million in net assets, even though they have attracted about $1.78 billion in cumulative net inflows since launch. The two figures measure different things: net assets reflect the falling market value of the XRP the funds hold, as well as money flowing in and out.

XRP's daily relative strength index, which measures the speed of price changes, has fallen below 30, a level usually considered oversold. Oversold readings can come before short-term rebounds, but they don't confirm the decline is over.

title: XRP News | XRP Drops to Two-Year Low Near 87 Cents as Spot ETF Assets Fall Below $1 Billion
